description: github: Activity. GET /v1/github/user/activity. Provide one of: handle, url. Get public GitHub profile contribution activity for a user. Defaults to the current year and returns one month at a time. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response. Pages backward by month through the selected year.

year.description: When provided, returns profile contribution activity for that year. Defaults to the current year.

name: github_user_activity
